cohort: The study included 90 women: 30 healthy pregnant women (control), 30 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), and 30 women with term premature rupture of membranes (TPROM).
finding: The expression of NLRP3 and caspase-1 in fetal membrane and placental tissues was significantly higher in the TPROM group compared to the PPROM and control groups, suggesting an association with PROM development.
cross-section timing: Tissue collection occurred at the time of premature rupture of membrane or delivery.
